test_title: PYST 73: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Identify the grammatical function of the phrase "offering a direct conduit between creator and audience" in the sentence:

"The platform enables unparalleled autonomy, offering a direct conduit between creator and audience, unmediated by corporate gatekeepers."

options.text: Present participial phrase functioning as an adverb
Noun phrase acting as an object

solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ***Option 2: Present participial phrase functioning as an adverb.***

 
 
• The phrase begins with **"offering,"** which is the **present participle** of the verb "offer."
